# All unpinned blobs are extracted from the stock SX4 firmware:
#   vendor/odm:  SHARP/SX4/SX4:15/AP3A.240905.015.A2/00WW_3_20A000:user/release-keys
#   system_ext:  SHARP/AquosMTK_SX4/AquosMTK:16/SB385/03.00.07:user/release-keys

# vendor/odm: generated by genblobs23.py from the 2026-09-03 readback (slot _b).
# Over-inclusive on purpose; converge against $OUT/vendor after the first build.
# *_dlkm partitions are fully build-generated (sx4-kernels), nothing to extract.
